title: BrickItem
description: Allows you to disable an item. Available for FabricMC!
body:
**REQUIRES: [Fabric Api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**

# BrickItem

Allows you to disable an item.

# Usage

All configuration is handled inside `config/BrickItem/BrickItem.json`

- `"disabled_items"`: A list of Identifiers (e.g. `minecraft:stone` or `stone`). Defaults to: `[]`
- `"disabled_message"`: The message that is shown when a player attempts to use a disabled item. Defaults to: `"§cThis item has been disabled!"`

**NOTE:**  You have to reload the config using `/brickitem reload`
